description: We are VENA2, a team from Yucatán, Mexico, taking on NASA Space Apps Farms. Our name honors the deer (venado), a symbol of our state and Mayan heritage. We're passionate about space tech, data, and sustainable agriculture, using NASA Earth data to help farmers face drought and climate change. Our tech stack: [Python, JavaScript, data analysis]. We're looking for a UX/UI designer. Join us!
